interface.title: AI Materials Screening
interface.field: Computational materials science / materials informatics (inorganic thermodynamic stability prediction)
interface.stage_of_work: Early candidate screening and prioritization, before DFT or experimental validation
interface.what_it_is_for: Score chemical compositions, one at a time or from a CSV batch, with a calibrated XGBoost model on Magpie features, giving stability probability, predictive uncertainty, OOD risk, a candidate score and feature contributions, then rank, filter, export and revisit the results.

data.note: sample_batch.csv (5 rows: LiFePO4, Al2O3, TiO2, an invalid 'not-a-formula' row and a duplicate LiFePO4; columns composition, candidate_id, project). It is the same file as the in-app 'Download sample CSV' button gives. I typed the single-prediction formulas myself: LiFePO4, NaCl, not-a-formula and PuNp3Cm2. The model artifacts are bundled with the tool (Materials Project training split).

tree.general: Rank candidate items by a model's estimate of how likely they are to be viable and how much to trust that estimate, so follow-up work goes to the best ones
tree.specific: Prioritize inorganic compositions for DFT or experiments using calibrated stability probability, uncertainty, OOD risk and candidate score

not_done: The built-in 'Download as CSV' icon in the dataframe toolbar (tried on the feature-contribution table) did not register a download in this headless browser. The app's own Download CSV/JSON buttons worked.
Single predictions are not saved to Screening History; only batch runs appear there (screens/040.webp). The history view has no export buttons of its own.
Charts do not follow the table filters: the scatter and bar chart stayed the same when filters emptied the table (screens/032.webp).
The 'Top-ranked candidates' bar chart stacks the duplicate LiFePO4 rows into one bar (~0.74) instead of showing them separately (screens/023.webp).
NaCl had OOD risk 63.5% but was still marked 'Within review threshold'. The exact review threshold is not stated in the UI.
Resetting the scatter zoom by double-click: the trace records only single clicks after the box zoom (steps 60-62), and the replay did not try it either, so reset was not shown.
